review.assessment: The diff creates a new solution.sh that pipes raw input through tr, sort, and uniq -c to tally frequencies. It fails to lowercase words for case-insensitive comparison, only splits on spaces rather than all whitespace characters, and sorts the final output alphabetically by word instead of by frequency descending as required.

findings.defect: Sorting order is alphabetical by word, not count descending.
Fails to split on tabs and newlines, only spaces.
